summary: Vivos Therapeutics filed an 8-K disclosing an amendment to its Exchange Agreement with Streeterville Capital, LLC. The original agreement allowed Streeterville to exchange a portion of Vivos’ outstanding indebtedness for preferred and common stock. The June 18, 2026 letter amendment extends the outside date for Vivos to complete a qualifying financing of at least $2,600,000 from June 15, 2026, to August 31, 2026. No board recommendation, advisors, share price, premium, or other deal terms are stated. This is a debt restructuring to manage liquidity. Watch whether Vivos secures the financing by the deadline to avoid potential conversion or default.
